Subject: MerchantGate renewal: onboarding timeline & commitment smoothing

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you are well. We're approaching the end of our current 12-month private offer and want to discuss renewal + a moderate capacity increase for Q4. Our usage spiked in August and September (attached summary) and procurement wants to avoid a surprise overage while keeping the invoice profile predictable for finance.

High-level asks from our side:
- Explore an 18-month term to smooth monthly budgeting
- Increase committed capacity by ~30% starting Jan 1, 2027
- Clarify any marketplace/private-offer paperwork (we're on AWS marketplace today) and whether we can split invoices across two legal entities for tax reasons

I've copied our procurement lead (merchantgate-procurement@merchantgate.com) for logistics. I attached the Q3 usage export for your reference. Can your team propose a cadence and docs you need to start the PO + private-offer flow?

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Cloud Ops | MerchantGate
elena.rossi@merchantgate.com
+44 7700 900123

Hi Elena — thanks for the detailed notes and the usage export. This is exactly the kind of data we need to size a smooth renewal.

Quick summary of next steps from our side:
1) We can support an 18-month term and a staged commitment increase effective 2027-01-01. That will help smooth month-to-month spend.
2) For AWS Private Offer paperwork we need: signed PO for the total committed amount, PO billing details (billing entity + tax ID), and the contact for invoice routing. We can accept a split-invoice approach but need the legal entities formalized before Docs sign-off.
3) I'll loop in Sales Ops (Marissa) for the private-offer setup and Marketplace compliance lead (Ben) for any technical acceptance items.

Proposed timeline:
- This week: confirm billing entities + PO recipient (MerchantGate to provide)
- Next week: Sales Ops prepares draft private-offer order form and pricing delta for +30% commit
- 10/18: 30-minute call to align on legal/finance workflow and DocuSign timeline

Do any of these times work for you on 10/18? 10am PT or 2pm PT are open on our side.

- Signed PO (total committed amount) — MerchantGate provided MG_PO_2026Q4.pdf which helps
- Customer billing entity(ies) and tax IDs (for invoice split)
- Account contact who approves charges + technical acceptance owner for rollout
- SOC 2 evidence window noted (we can share the secure evidence bucket link if they need it)

A) Single Private Offer with invoice routing to a single payer (preferred for one contract), or
B) Dual-entity arrangement where we set two private offers and map usage by account (more manual but possible).

Ben: can you confirm any acceptance/endpoint changes needed for the +30% commit? Does the customer need staged activation or can we provision immediately with a scheduled ramp?

Attaching our Private Offer playbook to speed the review.
